prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1456; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left-hand turn. Our client sustained injuries in this incident and is entitled to pursue a claim for the losses that followed. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter exclusively to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page. We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, repair estimates, telematics information, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please confirm in writing within fourteen days that these materials are being retained and that our instructions have been received.
